lines.text: No more annoying mosquitoes or buzzing flies sounds like paradise, right?
Think again. If every insect vanished, human civilization would collapse in less than a year.
Insects are the master pollinators of over eighty percent of all flowering plants and crops.
Without bees, beetles, and butterflies, apples, coffee, chocolate, and grains would vanish from grocery shelves.
Dead leaves, animal carcasses, and waste would pile up endlessly without beetle decomposers.
Birds, reptiles, and amphibians would starve to death, toppling global food pyramids.
Those tiny six-legged creatures are the invisible foundation keeping our entire planet alive.
